title: Retry with backoff
hints: Write the loop without waiting first: call `f`, return `nil` on success, and wrap the error once the last attempt has failed. Then add the wait between attempts, and only between them.

Keep a `delay` that starts at `base` and doubles after every wait; each wait uses `min(delay, maxDelay)` (the built-in `min`). Wait with `t := time.NewTimer(…)` and a `select` on `<-t.C` and `<-stop`. A receive from a `nil` `stop` never fires, so `nil` needs no extra code.

Loop `for call := 1; ; call++ { if err = f(); err == nil { return nil }; if call == attempts { return fmt.Errorf("retry: %d attempts failed: %w", attempts, err) }; … select …; delay *= 2 }`. In the `stop` case: `t.Stop()` and `return fmt.Errorf("%w after %d attempts: %w", ErrStopped, call, err)`.
